input: Practice mindfulness meditation for ten minutes daily

gold.taskTitle: Build a daily ten-minute mindfulness meditation habit
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to practice mindfulness meditation for ten minutes every day and needs a structured plan to make it a consistent habit.

questions.title: What time of day do you plan to meditate?
questions.description: Understanding the preferred time slot helps anchor the habit to an existing routine.

questions.title: Have you meditated before, or is this brand new?
questions.description: Knowing the experience level shapes how beginner-friendly the plan needs to be.

questions.title: Which meditation style appeals to you most right now?
questions.description: For example: breath focus, body scan, guided audio, or silent sitting.

questions.title: What is your main reason for starting this practice?
questions.description: The underlying motivation, such as stress relief, focus, or sleep, helps tailor the approach.

questions.title: Where will you physically sit to meditate each day?
questions.description: Having a dedicated, distraction-free space is key to forming the habit reliably.

questions.title: Do you want to use an app, timer, or guided recordings?
questions.description: Knowing the preferred tools determines what resources need to be set up in advance.

questions.title: How will you track whether you stuck to the habit?
questions.description: A journaling method, app streak, or calendar mark-off affects the accountability structure.
